describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing side profile against a plain off-white background, with a stocky, bear-like body covered in dense, shaggy brown fur that is darker on the lower legs and lighter tan on the muzzle, cheeks and lower flanks. Its back from the shoulders to the hindquarters is covered by a large, domed, glossy dark reddish-brown shell resembling a beetle's elytra, divided into two main sections, and a single long, dark, curved horn projects upward and backward from its forehead. It stands on four thick, clawed legs with a small furry tail at the rear, giving the overall appearance of a bear-beetle hybrid.

describe.description: A large quadrupedal mammal covered in dense shaggy brown fur, standing in right profile. The body, head, legs, paws with claws, small rounded ears, and short stub tail are bear-like, with a lighter tan muzzle and underparts. A single long, curved, glossy dark-brown horn rises from the forehead and curves backward. Covering the back from behind the shoulders to the rump is a large, glossy, dark-brown two-part domed shell with fine transverse ribbing and a segmented rim, like a beetle's elytra.
